The compromise is baby wearing, which is great for both of us, but less great for my back since she is in the 95th percentile! Enter TushBaby. A coworker recommended the hip seat/carrier combo to me, and it a BACK SAVER. I get me work done, she gets a great nap, and my back doesn't hurt. Also, this carrier is structurally way higher quality than the other 4 carriers I own. Plus the hip seat has pockets for your phone, pacifier, water bottle, diapers, wipes. I mean, what can't this carrier do?!
